title: Open-weight AI, abliterators, redistributors + hosting - the de-censoring counter-ecosystem chronology
source: Public record: model releases (Llama/Mistral/Qwen/DeepSeek); Hugging Face / Ollama / OpenRouter; abliteration research + Heretic tooling. Chronology overlay (structural; no financial-core edges). TAXONOMY: these are mostly LLMs (one branch of AI); the block tracks the open-weight + uncensoring pathway, distinct from frontier-lab safety posture. HONESTY: releases/licenses/tools = fact; 'undercuts served-model safety' = interpretation (the open-weight paradox), labeled.

edges.notes: Meta's Llama (2023-) anchored the open-WEIGHT era - downloadable models that anyone can run/fine-tune locally, splitting the field from closed frontier APIs (fact).
Alibaba's Qwen (Apache-2.0) became one of the most-used open-weight families globally - the China-open-weight pole (fact).
Hugging Face is the dominant model REDISTRIBUTOR/hub - Llama, Qwen, Mistral, DeepSeek weights are mirrored + versioned there for mass download (fact).
DeepSeek's open-weight releases (R1/V-series) distribute via Hugging Face - the efficient-open pole reaching the world through the hub (fact; cf fin-ai-efficiency-counter-thesis).

OpenRouter is a model-API AGGREGATOR/router; by Q2 2026 Chinese open models (DeepSeek/Qwen/GLM) crossed ~30% of its developer token traffic - the demand-side of the open/efficient shift (fact; cf the China-AI reroute thread).

Ollama (+ llama.cpp) makes local, offline model-running trivial - the substrate for the private/uncensored counter-ecosystem where served-model guardrails don't apply (fact; cf the local/uncensored-AI block).

Heretic + similar tools automate ABLITERATION - editing an open model's weights to remove refusal behavior - turning a censored-when-served model into an uncensored local one (fact of technique; quality varies).
Abliteration/fine-tuning is how open weights are re-released 'uncensored' - the mechanism of the de-censoring layer (fact).

THE OPEN-WEIGHT PARADOX: once weights are public they are de-censorable downstream, so served-model safety + frontier regulation are LEAKY - a structural check on the safety-regulation story (interpretation, labeled; the leak itself is demonstrated).

Chinese open-weight models ship with built-in state-alignment when served, yet are freely de-censorable once downloaded - both censored-at-source AND uncensorable-material, the paradox bridging the China-AI stack to the local-AI ecosystem (fact of licenses + demonstrated de-censoring; quality-variable).
